rules.lines: E34's on this card (scored): faith_score.verdict with the L40 W0 floor f = 0.20878: pass at ratio <= 1.5/(1+f) = 1.24086, fail at ratio >= 1.5(1+f) = 1.81316, inconclusive between; E39/E122's fixed 1.40 / 1.61 reported beside under the same rules

outcome.R3 pass, R4 fail: closeness to the fine-tune and faithfulness pull apart on narrow updates too

outcome.R3 fail, R4 pass: reversed: the least-squares start gives the more faithful copy
outcome.anything else: no call: R3 <set verdict>, R4 <set verdict> (mixed, inconclusive or below P); reported as read, no amendment

rules.R4_start, nothing: verdicts reported, not in the outcome

power: No positive control on this task: the update itself, all in Delta, reads 1.39 on the L40 (n2), inconclusive by E34's lines and a pass by E39's. A copy's pass therefore cannot be told from leaving the update in Delta; a fail (>= 1.81) is readable: that copy's decomposition is worse under the check than the update left in Delta. E34's SGD-on-windows copies (r0, r1: 3.1-3.4, H100) and E122's least-squares copy (9.4, L40) show the check can read a fail on this apparatus.
blind_to: the stochastic half of E34's verdict (not run; it read 0.87-1.02 on every E34 state); rows other than Pile val 0-255; adversary seeds other than 0; per-position structure of the excess
